notes: The source page is the Advanced Technical Theatre Certificate (program code 2C42491, total 34-44.5 units), not the Technical Theatre Certificate named here. The Technical Theatre Certificate appears only as a navigation link; its own requirements are not printed in the text, so no blocks were recorded.

total_units 18-23 comes from the Advanced certificate description: 'requires completion of the Technical Theatre Certificate (18-23 units)'. This range fits the 16-to-under-30-unit award type. A reviewer should confirm it against the Technical Theatre Certificate page.

The program student learning outcomes and the career fields on the page (theatrical productions, corporate events, theme parks, television, film studios) belong to the Advanced Technical Theatre Certificate. They were not recorded for this award.

All nine closed-list courses appear in the Advanced certificate's lists. THEA 141 F, 143 F, 160 F and 170 F are required there; THEA 153 F and 159 F are stage crew activity courses; THEA 130 F, 134 F and 178 F are production courses. This suggests the Technical Theatre Certificate is the base subset, but its rules must come from its own catalog page: https://catalog.nocccd.edu/fullerton-college/degrees-certificates/theatre-arts-drama/technical-theatre-certificate/ (likely URL).
